notes.title: We have updated Roll of Fate (October 16, 2024)
notes.content:
What's new:

[list]
[*] We rewrote and improved the logic scripts for Elena/Winston/Isabella - no more sudden appearances
[*] Fixed inaccuracies in the visual accompaniment
[*] Improved background track - now it’s longer and less repetitive
[*] Corrected the Russian text - removed all word repetitions and punctuation errors
[*] Fixed a bug where text and portraits disappeared after a dice roll
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed skipping the class selection
[*] Optimized paths for the "back" button
[/list]

notes.title: We have updated Roll of Fate (23.09.2024)
notes.content:
What's new:

[list]
[*] Added windowed mode
[*] Fixed screen resolution errors
[*] Fixed issues with incorrect saving of endings – now completed endings are not reset when starting a new game
[*] Fixed restart issues after the end of the game – scripts now work correctly
[*] Fixed issues with Isabella's path – the game no longer breaks during the bear scene
[*] Optimized code for dice rolls
[*] Fixed errors in game logic – you will now encounter far fewer empty blocks
[*] Fixed button size in the choice menu – text now fits in all languages
[/list]

notes.title: We've updated Roll of Fate (August 5, 2024)
notes.content:
What's new:

[list]
[*] The game page on Steam has been updated - now the description of the game's features is accompanied by bright, stylized graphics.
[*] Fixed the description on the Steam page - typos and minor errors have been removed.
[*] Fixed issues with the "auto" button - it no longer causes a "blue screen" to appear.
[*] Auto button scripts have been debugged - you will definitely not miss important plot moments and choices.
[*] Fixed rewinding back - the text no longer disappears.
[*] We continue to work on improving the dice roll functionality - compatibility issues with some systems have been fixed.
[*] General improvements to the code's performance.
[/list]

We are grateful to everyone who purchased Roll of Fate and left honest reviews about our game. We take into account the experience and opinions of our dear players and improve the game. We are always open to constructive criticism and suggestions from those interested in the debut work of the 7Cats.Team.

We also plan to release small notes in the format of "developer diaries" so that everyone interested can learn about our team, our plans, and future products.

With love and respect, the 7Cats.Team

notes.title: We have updated Roll of Fate (19.07.2024)
notes.content:
What's new:

[list]
[*] Added the ability to quickly scroll through text using the spacebar.

[*] Added breakpoints for quickly scrolling text - you won't miss a choice or an important check.

[*] General dice roll improvements.
[/list]

We do not stop working on improving Roll of Fate and we are grateful to everyone who left us feedback about our game. Your support is very important to us. 

With love and respect, 7Cats.Team
